title: Avocado and Grated Egg on Toast with Everything Bagel Seasoning Recipe
ldName: Avocado and grated egg on toast with everything bagel seasoning
ldKeywords: avocado, egg on toast, everything bagel, easy
ldInstructionsRaw: Place the eggs into a pot large enough to hold them in a single layer and cover with cold water by 1 inch
Bring to the boil, then turn off the heat and cover the pot. Set aside for 10 minutes
Transfer the eggs to a bowl of iced water and chill for 5 minutes
Combine all the ingredients for the everything bagel seasoning
Slice the avocado and place half on top of each piece of toast, topping with a small squeeze of lemon juice
Grate the hard boiled eggs on top using a microplane grater
Top with everything bagel seasoning, olive oil and chilli flakes to taste
